metadata.audit_name: HVA-02 Human Feedback Value Decomposition & Reusability Audit
metadata.mode: READ-ONLY RESEARCH AUDIT / NO IMPLEMENTATION / FROZEN INTACT / STOP
metadata.predecessors: HVA-01, DCE-05/06/07, L5 Learning Signal Audit, Info Gain Audit, Feedback Reuse Audit

executive_summary.key_finding: Human Feedback has been CAPTURED but not REUSED. 5 candidates exist, none reached L4. Stability-Novelty Paradox: stable signals redundant, novel signals unstable. Only cross-document signal (period+capital) has 33% FP on P7.

current_human_feedback_loop.key_observation: 91% of feedback is REDUNDANT CONFIRMATION. Only 9% contains potentially new information.

v1_review_value.summary: Only 5/45 (11%) have genuine Review Value. 87% could be resolved without human.

F3.description: Reveals period+capital relation (existing P1, system ignores)

F4.description: Adjudicated — exposes sentence vs paragraph boundary

v2_feedback_information_gain.key_finding: F3/F4 (15%) are the ONLY feedback with potential new information. All 4 F4 cases share SAME pattern: period_end + cap_start.

signal_candidates.name: TABLE_NUMERIC_DIFF_CELL → SPLIT
signal_candidates.reason: Stable but redundant (LOW info gain). Machine already has TLD evidence. Ceiling effect. 5 cases on resnet p6 = NOT 5 independent.

signal_candidates.name: SENTENCE_BOUNDARY_PERIOD_CAPITAL → SPLIT
signal_candidates.reason: Cross-doc recurrence BUT 5/15 P7 FP (33%). Boundary unstable (reviewer disagreement). Period+capital NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT.

signal_candidates.name: FIGURE_CAPTION → MERGE
signal_candidates.reason: Stable but 1 doc only, LOW info gain.

signal_candidates.name: MIXED_NUMERIC_TEXT → SPLIT
signal_candidates.reason: Stable but VERY LOW info gain (redundant). No negatives (ceiling).

signal_candidates.name: DCE-02 PERIOD+CAPITAL (expanded validation)
signal_candidates.reason: 33% FP on P7. Pattern is corpus-specific. NOT generalizable.

signal_candidates.name: AMB-032 Evidence Distillation Gap
signal_candidates.reason: One-off. Reveals B2 doesnt expose TLD info. Not a reusable signal, its a system presentation issue.

signal_candidates.name: AMB-375 Genuine Boundary
signal_candidates.reason: Genuine boundary but reviewer disagreement. Unstable. P7 has 5 counterexamples.

v3_reusable_signal_potential.key_finding: No signal reached R5 or R6. Highest is R4 but with 33% false positives.

sentence_vs_paragraph.reason: Reviewer disagreement (3/3) + 5/15 P7 FP. Boundary is genuine but UNSTABLE.

figure_caption_vs_body.reason: Stable but only 1 document, LOW info gain.

abstention_boundary.AMB-032: B2 UNKNOWN — evidence distillation gap (NOT judgment boundary)
abstention_boundary.AMB-375: B2 UNKNOWN — genuine abstention boundary (period+capital insufficient)
abstention_boundary.key_finding: AMB-375 reveals genuine abstention boundary but it is UNSTABLE.

amb032_analysis.new_information: YES — B2 fails to expose TLD different_cell
amb032_analysis.evidence_grounded: YES — TLD has info, B2 doesnt expose it
amb032_analysis.verdict: One-off useful feedback (NOT reusable signal). L3 Evidence Distillation Value.

amb375_analysis.human_b2: UNKNOWN (31.3s, 7 exp) + KEEP_SEPARATE (3.5s, 0 exp, cue followed)
amb375_analysis.new_information: YES — exposes sentence vs paragraph boundary
amb375_analysis.cross_document: YES — 3 IS-11 docs + 4 P7 docs = 7 docs
amb375_analysis.future_validation: MEDIUM — 15 P7 cases, but 5 are counterexamples (MERGE)
amb375_analysis.reuse_level: R2 (repeated) to R4 (cross-doc) but NOT R5 (not stable)
amb375_analysis.verdict: Potential reusable signal BUT unstable. Boundary is genuine but not universal.

why_no_reusable_signal: Human correction is VISUAL, not evidence-based
TLD failure mechanism identified (DCE-06) but UNFIXABLE (DCE-07)
No generalizable rule can be extracted
amb135_counterexample.verdict: Type B (Machine Error / Low Reuse). Case-specific and unfixable.

AMB-313.reason: Human uses page visual. System doesnt have page visual. Cannot learn.

AMB-462.reason: Human uses page visual. text_ratio=0.163 inherent. DCE-07 cant fix.

amb313_462_analysis.verdict: Both are Evidence Perception Failure (L1), NOT Feedback Learning Opportunity (L3/L4).

sig02_period_capital.conclusion: NOT universal. Period+capital is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT.

cross_case_recurrence.independence_warning: SIG-01 has 5 cases on resnet page 6 — NOT 5 independent examples. Same table, same page. Counts as 1 independent observation.

cross_document_recurrence.key_finding: Only SIG-02 has cross-document recurrence with counterexamples. All others either lack independence or have ceiling effect.

future_validation_availability.key_finding: Only SIG-02/SIG-08 have meaningful future cases (15 P7). But 5/15 are counterexamples. No signal has future cases WITHOUT counterexamples.

tld_feedback_value_matrix.key_finding: HIGH feedback value does NOT concentrate on TLD failure. Highest-value case (AMB-032) has TLD CORRECT. TLD failure cases all produce snap judgments.
tld_feedback_value_matrix.conclusion: TLD = Independent Evidence Quality Problem. NOT the human learning bottleneck.

case_selection_feedback_value.critical_finding: 100% of HIGH-value cases are PROSE or non-table content. 0/40 TABLE cases have HIGH reuse value. Current selection (88% TABLE) systematically EXCLUDES highest-value content.
case_selection_feedback_value.p7_caveat: P7 human review data incomplete (all labels UNKNOWN). Cannot confirm without human review.

four_layer_value_summary.key_gap: Gap between V1/V2 (human can provide value) and V3/V4 (value can be reused) is the core problem.

failure_missing_evidence.ceiling_effect: 96% KEEP_SEPARATE, 0 negative cases, 0 CONFLICT, 0 UNKNOWN in candidates
failure_missing_evidence.stability_novelty_paradox: Stable signals redundant (Machine has evidence). Novel signals unstable (reviewer disagreement).
failure_missing_evidence.image_confound: Human always sees page image. Corrections often visual-based. n=1 participant.
failure_missing_evidence.no_future_cases: 0 independent future cases for most signals. Only SIG-02 has 15 P7 but with counterexamples.
failure_missing_evidence.content_type_bias: IS-11 88% TABLE → 0/40 TABLE have HIGH reuse. 100% HIGH-value are PROSE/FIGURE.

final_research_judgment.Q1_reason: No signal reached R5/R6. Highest R4 has 33% FP. All stable signals redundant. All novel signals unstable. 0 future cases without counterexamples.
final_research_judgment.Q2_why_not: MIXED — (1) Feedback itself limited (91% redundant). (2) System doesnt distill evidence for human (AMB-032). (3) Not enough repeated cases (4 adjudicated, all same pattern).

Q4_amb032_amb375.AMB-032: One-off useful feedback (NOT reusable signal). L3 Evidence Distillation Value. R1.
Q4_amb032_amb375.AMB-375: Potential reusable signal BUT unstable. R2-R4 but NOT R5. Boundary genuine but not universal.

final_research_judgment.Q5_next_step: VALIDATION not engineering. No signal reached R5. Cannot skip to engineering. Need P7 human review + more participants + image-free test.

next_route_recommendation.L2_case_selection: Redesign to include PROSE/BOUNDARY content (P7 BODY_TEXT, REFERENCE). 100% HIGH-value are non-table.
next_route_recommendation.L3_evidence_distillation: Redesign B2 to expose TLD structural info. AMB-032 proves B2 fails. B2 slower than A.
next_route_recommendation.L4_feedback_generalization: Address Stability-Novelty Paradox. Need diverse cases, more participants, image-free test.
next_route_recommendation.L1_tld: Independent problem, NOT primary. DCE-07 closed locality route.
next_route_recommendation.note: Does NOT authorize implementation. Identifies future research focus.

forbidden_escalations: Evidence Distillation Gap → Evidence Organization Engine
